description: Edit selected fields of a ChatGPT ad draft; pass its latest revision from get_chatgpt_ads. For a launched ad, creative/targeting/bid/duration changes require replacement=true and a new requestKey: this creates a replacement DRAFT and leaves the original unchanged. Clearly explain this, show the new quote, then start the replacement and end the original only as authorized. Use update_chatgpt_ad_budget for a live budget-only edit.

campaignId.description: oriiion campaign ID returned by these tools, never an external account/ad ID.

changes.description: Only the ad fields to change.

replacement.description: Required true to change creative/targeting/bid/duration of a launched ad: creates a replacement draft. Default false.

requestKey.description: Generate one UUID for this operation and reuse it on retries.

revision.description: The draft’s latest revision UUID from get_chatgpt_ads; rejects the edit if it changed meanwhile.

name: edit_chatgpt_ad
